targets.name: M3Cargo
targets.objective: Move from PUBLIC_CANDIDATE toward DOCUMENTS_VERIFIED by validating legal entity, China presence, 1688 capability, commercial terms and importer/customs responsibility.
requestItems: Current Romanian company registration extract for M3EUROPE S.R.L. / CUI 47734607
Documents or business registration evidence for the China operating entity/entities used for sourcing, warehousing or payments
Addresses and legal names of China warehouses/operations used for Shenzhen, Ningbo and Yiwu flows
Written confirmation that the team can source directly from 1688 and whether buyer-side account access is required
Written fee model: sourcing fee, commission, inspection fee, consolidation fee, payment-transfer fee and logistics margin where applicable
Supplier payment model: who receives customer funds, who pays supplier, payment currency, refund/dispute procedure and transaction documents supplied to client
Importer-of-record model for Romania/EU and when the client appears on customs documents
MRN/customs declaration and VAT evidence made available to the client for each importer model
Written responsibility matrix for customs classification, duty, VAT, compliance documents and product restrictions
Cargo insurance coverage, exclusions and claims procedure
Sample ordering, QC and consolidation workflow for small test batches
Typical air and sea options for a 20–30 unit test shipment and minimum charge structure
Two recent client references, ideally Romanian e-commerce/import clients
Example anonymized inspection/QC report
Example anonymized landed-cost/transport quote showing line-item charges
requiredWrittenAnswers: Can you source and negotiate directly on 1688?
Can MPR/client select the exact supplier and receive supplier identity before payment?
Do you accept independent pre-shipment inspection or provide your own documented QC?
Who is importer of record under each service option?
Can the client receive MRN and import VAT/customs evidence when legally applicable?
What happens if supplier quality fails before shipment?
What happens if goods are lost/damaged in transit?
Are there minimum order values or minimum shipment charges?
Can you support a small 20–30 unit commercial test?

realServiceTestBeforeApproval.scope: One small sourcing/quote/QC/logistics case using a real MPR candidate after internal gates permit it

targets.name: ROMASIA
targets.objective: Validate Romanian/China legal entities, published Yiwu/Guangzhou presence, 1688 capability and the claimed importer-on-ROMASIA Romanian-invoice model.
requestItems: Current Romanian company registration extract and CUI for the contracting Romanian entity
China/Hong Kong company registration documents for the entities used in sourcing/trading
Evidence linking the published Yiwu and Guangzhou offices/warehouse to the operating company
Written confirmation of direct 1688 sourcing capability
Written fee model for sourcing/trading, inspection, consolidation, payment handling and transport
Written explanation of the service where import is performed on ROMASIA's company and the customer receives Romanian invoices
For the ROMASIA-importer model: contract party, importer of record, ownership transfer point, VAT treatment, customs liability and documents supplied to client
For direct-import model if available: MRN/customs declaration and VAT evidence supplied to client
Supplier identity disclosure and payment flow before customer funds are committed
Cargo insurance and claims terms
Sample/QC/consolidation workflow for small test batches
Two recent Romanian client references
Example anonymized supplier-audit or goods-inspection report
Example anonymized quote showing sourcing/logistics cost breakdown
requiredWrittenAnswers: Can you source directly on 1688 and negotiate with factories there?
Can the client know the exact supplier identity and ex-factory price?
Under which model is ROMASIA the importer of record?
Under that model, which customs/import documents can the client legally receive?
How are product compliance responsibilities allocated between ROMASIA and the client?
What happens if QC fails before shipment?
Can you support a 20–30 unit test or do minimum fees make that impractical?

realServiceTestBeforeApproval.scope: One small sourcing/quote/QC/logistics case using a real MPR candidate after internal gates permit it
